db:select.doc:name: Last successful poll
db:select.db:sql: SELECT window_end_utc FROM audit_poll_run WHERE status = 'success' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import some from dw::core::Arrays output application/java var excluded = vars.settings['audit.exclude_actions'] default [] var all = (payload.data default payload) default [] var names = (all map ((a) -> if (a is Object) (a.name default a.action default a.id) else a)) filter ((n) -> n != null) var allowed = names filter ((n) -> not (excluded some ((x) -> lower(x) == lower(n as String)))) --- if (isEmpty(allowed)) null else allowed

logger.message: #['Could not load audit actions, filtering client-side: ' ++ (error.description default '')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import normalizeEvent, isExcluded from modules::risk output application/java var excluded = vars.settings['audit.exclude_actions'] default [] --- ((vars.rawEvents map ((r) -> normalizeEvent(r, vars.auditRules))) filter ((e) -> not isExcluded(e, excluded))) distinctBy ((e) -> e.event_id)
%dw 2.0 import auditAlerts from modules::alerts import nowIso from modules::util output application/java --- auditAlerts(vars.auditEvents, nowIso())

db:bulk-insert.doc:name: Insert audit events
db:bulk-insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO audit_event (event_id, event_ts, action, subaction, object_type, object_name, user_name, org_id, env_id, risk, raw_json) VALUES (:event_id, :event_ts, :action, :subaction, :object_type, :object_name, :user_name, :org_id, :env_id, :risk, :raw_json)

db:insert.doc:name: Poll run: success
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO audit_poll_run (window_start_utc, window_end_utc, status, events_fetched, events_stored, message, created_at) VALUES (:ws, :we, 'success', :fetched, :stored, :msg, :at)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 import nowIso from modules::util --- { ws: vars.auditWindow.start, we: vars.auditWindow.end, fetched: sizeOf(vars.rawEvents), stored: sizeOf(vars.auditEvents), msg: "$(sizeOf(vars.newAlerts)) alerts raised; api filter " ++ (if (vars.actionWhitelist != null) "on" else "off"), at: nowIso() }]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (vars.jobMessage default '') ++ ' audit: ' ++ sizeOf(vars.auditEvents) ++ ' events, ' ++ sizeOf(vars.newAlerts) ++ ' alerts;']

db:insert.doc:name: Poll run: failed
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO audit_poll_run (window_start_utc, window_end_utc, status, events_fetched, events_stored, message, created_at) VALUES (:ws, :we, 'failed', 0, 0, :msg, :at)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 import nowIso, truncate from modules::util --- { ws: vars.auditWindow.start, we: vars.auditWindow.end, msg: truncate(error.description default 'error', 4000), at: nowIso() }]

http:request.doc:name: Audit query
http:request.http:body: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { startDate: vars.auditWindow.start, endDate: vars.auditWindow.end, (actions: vars.actionWhitelist) if (vars.actionWhitelist != null), ascending: true, offset: vars.offset default 0, limit: vars.pageSize }]
